payload.rationale: Journey stage is 'planning' (brief): a couple choosing an RSVP tool type for a multi-event destination weekend, which maps to the Concierge consultation under 'Comparing' in services.md. The copy already carries every CTA, so this stage records them as they stand and adds nothing. Secondary: the Concierge link closing 'Getting every reply in'. Closing: a third Concierge link (utm_content=closing) ends the article; its lead-in carries the only fee wording allowed, taken from brand-facts.md ('the fee agreed in writing before any work begins'), alongside 'one Wedded Advisor, start to finish, as a single point of contact' and the venue, travel, vendors and payments scope. The schema has two CTA slots, so the closing link is recorded in tracking. Anchor text on all three is 'Wedded Concierge' (two words, no 'click here', no exclamation mark); the services.md default 'Speak with a Wedded Advisor' is not substituted because the copy is recorded as is. No subtext is recorded because the copy has none beside the primary or secondary link. Magazine: /magazine exists in link-map.csv (lead magnet, row 307) and is linked once with utm_content=magnet; the services.md default magazine wording is not used because it contains a word the brief bans. Wonderland Studio is a contextual link to /wonderland-studio (link-map row 659), not a CTA, with no pricing or tier claims. Lead magnet suggestion: the ideal magnet for this reader is a booking checklist (questions to ask any RSVP website, plus a destination RSVP question set covering events, arrival and departure dates, accommodation, households, meals and time zones). It has no page, so exists is false and it is not placed; it is a build suggestion for the site team. Panel CTA reactions: three 'maybe' or 'no' reactions turn on the Advisor fee and how it is charged, which brand-facts.md defers, so the copy cannot answer them before the CTA; these sit in open questions rather than copy changes. All three target paths (/wonderland-concierge row 656, /magazine row 307, /wonderland-studio row 659) are confirmed in link-map.csv.
